description: Validate a GeoJSON document's structure against RFC 7946: the correct geometry type and coordinates shape for each of the seven geometry types, linear ring closure for Polygon/MultiPolygon, a Feature's required properties/geometry members, and a FeatureCollection's required features array. Also returns non-failing warnings when a Polygon ring winds the "wrong" way under RFC 7946's right-hand rule recommendation. Pure structural validation; no map is rendered and no tile server is contacted.

geojson.description: The GeoJSON document, as a JSON string

name: validate_geojson
